content_zh:
天水城，秦家。
“秦浩少主。”
一条古色古香的走廊上，数名秦家仆人见到正前方一名锦衣少年，顿时语气无比崇敬的纷纷开口。
“嗯。”
秦浩笑了笑，点头打了个招呼，走进厢房内。
“秦浩少主乃天水城第一天才，却没有一点架子，为人和蔼可亲，难怪万象殿这样的武学圣地，会特遣使者，想要将秦浩少主提前招入万象殿。”
“是啊，天水城其他天才，必须要经过天才选拔战，前三名才能进入万象殿，那都是八辈子修来的福气。
而使者大人会亲自给秦浩少主检测武魂，只要武魂在三品以上，就可以直接提前招入。
秦浩少主的武魂，肯定在三品以上啊！”
“这还用说，当年秦浩少主仅仅三个月，便将黄级初阶武技虎啸拳修炼大成，完成淬体也只用短短三日，打破天水城有史以来最快记录，这样的天才，天水城百年一遇！
依我看，秦浩少主的武魂至少是四品……”
“嘶，四品武魂的超级天才，咱们天水城多少年没出现过了！”
武魂乃武者根本，共分十品，品级越高，代表着武道天赋越高。
天水城这些年诞生的天才，武魂最高不过三品，四品武魂，已经近三十年未曾出现。
厢房内。
秦浩轻呼口气，摇头不已。
对其他人而言，能让万象殿亲派使者前来，可谓光宗耀祖之事，可对秦浩而言，却是完全打乱了他的计划。
秦浩一心向武，万象殿作为方圆万里内传承近千年的第一势力，自然也是秦浩一心想要拜入的武学圣地。
只是他原本的计划，是在三个月后的万象天才战上，获得前三进入万象殿。
现在万象殿却派特使，欲将他提前招收。

“万象殿使者突然来到，可我已经裂魂三次，若这时停下，之前三次裂魂便是白费。”
来到床边，秦浩沉心静气。
当年他三个月将一门黄级低阶武技修炼大成，而别人一年都未必做到，加之秦浩完成淬体仅用三日，因此引得万象殿注意。
甚至有万象殿长老断言，秦浩的武魂，至少在四品以上，此事一度引起天水城疯狂，秦浩被誉为天水城无可争议的第一天才。
秦浩盘腿而坐，自忖道：“既然如此，不如将裂魂继续下去，至于明日的武魂检测，便顺其自然吧。”
“天地造化，万物初始，归于本源……”
“哼！”
一股股剧痛从身体深处传来。
武魂，深藏人体内。
唯有年龄达到十岁，才会塑形，塑形后可吸纳灵气进行修炼，而因为深藏人体内，检测起来极为之难，唯有万象殿的特殊武魂水晶球，才能检测武魂品级。
所有人都在期待，秦浩到底是几品武魂，却没有人知道，实际上秦浩早在一年前，便利用秘法，检测出了自己的武魂！
秦浩，乃是五品武魂！
如此高等级别的武魂，在天水城堪称数百年一遇，放在万象殿，都是一等一的顶尖天才！
不过秦浩并没有沾沾自喜，而是施展秘法，强行将五品武魂打碎，重塑成了二品。
今日，秦浩要进行第四次重塑，将武魂塑造成最低等的一品！
咔咔咔……
“啊！”
一股天地力量，猛地降在他体内深处的武魂上，武魂乃人之根本，武魂碎裂，其痛苦不亚于灵魂被撕碎。
秦浩身体如筛糠般颤抖，低吼一声，昏死过去。
不知道过去多久，秦浩幽幽醒来，只感到体内传来一阵酥麻的感觉，不由脸色狂喜。

“一品武魂，成功了！”
果然。
他体内原本五品的武魂，此刻已经变成了最低等的一品武魂。
content_en:
Tianshui City, Qin Family.
"Young Master Qin Hao."
In an antique corridor, several servants of the Qin family saw a young man in brocade clothes in front of them, and they all spoke with great reverence.
"Yeah."
Qin Hao smiled, nodded and said hello, and walked into the side room.
"Young Master Qin Hao is the number one genius in Tianshui City, but he has no airs and is very amiable. No wonder a martial arts holy place like Wanxiang Hall would send special envoys to recruit Young Master Qin Hao into Wanxiang Hall in advance."
"Yes, other geniuses in Tianshui City must go through the genius selection competition, and the top three can enter the Wanxiang Palace. This is the blessing gained from eight lifetimes of cultivation.
The Master Messenger will personally test the martial souls for Young Master Qin Hao. As long as the martial souls are above the third level, they can be directly recruited in advance.
Young Master Qin Hao's martial spirit must be above the third level! "
"It goes without saying that Young Master Qin Hao mastered the Huang-level martial arts Tiger Roaring Fist in just three months, and completed the body tempering in just three days, breaking the fastest record in the history of Tianshui City. Such a genius is only seen once in a hundred years in Tianshui City!
In my opinion, Young Master Qin Hao’s martial spirit is at least the fourth grade..."
"Hiss, a super genius with a fourth-grade martial spirit has not appeared in our Tianshui City for many years!"
Martial spirit is the foundation of a warrior, and is divided into ten levels. The higher the level, the higher the martial arts talent.
The geniuses born in Tianshui City in recent years have no more than third-grade martial souls, and fourth-grade martial souls have not appeared in nearly thirty years.
In the wing room.
Qin Hao breathed lightly and shook his head.
To others, having the Wanxiang Palace personally send an envoy was a matter of honor for the ancestors, but for Qin Hao, it completely disrupted his plan.
Qin Hao devoted himself to martial arts, and the Wanxiang Palace, as the number one force within a radius of thousands of miles that had been inherited for nearly a thousand years, was naturally the holy place of martial arts that Qin Hao wanted to worship.
It’s just that his original plan was to get into the top three in the Vientiane Genius Competition three months later and enter the Vientiane Hall.
Now the Wanxiang Palace has sent a special envoy to recruit him in advance.
"The envoy from the Wanxiang Palace suddenly arrived, but I have already split my soul three times. If I stop now, the previous three soul splits will be in vain."
When he came to the bedside, Qin Hao calmed down.
Back then, he mastered a low-level Huang-level martial skill in three months, while others might not be able to do it in a year. In addition, it only took Qin Hao three days to complete the body tempering, so he attracted the attention of the Wanxiang Palace.
An elder from the Wanxiang Hall even asserted that Qin Hao's martial spirit was at least level four. This incident once caused Tianshui City to go crazy. Qin Hao was hailed as the undisputed number one genius in Tianshui City.
Qin Hao sat cross-legged and thought to himself: "In this case, it is better to continue the soul splitting. As for tomorrow's martial soul test, let nature take its course."
"The creation of heaven and earth, the beginning of all things, return to their origin..."
"Hmph!"
Waves of severe pain came from deep within the body.
The martial spirit is hidden deep inside the human body.
Only those who reach the age of ten can shape themselves. After shaping, they can absorb spiritual energy for practice. However, because it is hidden deep in the human body, it is extremely difficult to detect. Only the special martial soul crystal ball in the Wanxiang Palace can detect the martial soul level.
Everyone is looking forward to finding out what level of martial spirit Qin Hao is, but no one knows. In fact, Qin Hao used a secret method to detect his own martial spirit as early as a year ago!
Qin Hao is a fifth-grade martial spirit!
Such a high-level martial spirit is a once-in-a-hundred-year encounter in Tianshui City. If placed in the Wanxiang Palace, they are all top-notch geniuses!
However, Qin Hao did not feel complacent, but used a secret method to forcibly break the fifth-grade martial spirit into pieces and reshape it into a second-grade soul.
Today, Qin Hao will carry out his fourth reshaping, shaping his martial soul into the lowest level!
Click, click, click...
"Ah!"
A force of heaven and earth suddenly descended on the martial soul deep inside his body. The martial soul is the foundation of human beings. When the martial soul is shattered, the pain is no less than that of the soul being torn apart.
Qin Hao's body trembled like chaff, he roared and passed out.
I don’t know how long it has been, Qin Hao faintlyWhen I woke up, I felt a numb feeling in my body, and I couldn't help but look ecstatic.
"First-grade martial spirit, successful!"
Sure enough.
The originally fifth-grade martial soul in his body had now become the lowest first-grade martial soul.
